methods.underfarmed: Score 0-100 = 25*low TVL (1 at <=$5M, 0 at $1B, x0.7 under $0.5M) + 20*funding vs TVL (log10(raised/TVL): 0.01x=0, 10x=1) + 15*young (1 - days since TVL first >$100K / 540) + 15*quiet (1 - crypto headlines in 90d / 25, x (1 - airdrops.io heat/150)) + 15*points evidence (1 found, 0.3 unknown) + 10*token hint (near 1, mid 0.7, far 0.4, overdue 0.3, unknown 0.2) + 3 if top-tier backer; -8 if TVL fell >60% in 90d; -10 if live 3+ years; -12 if a CoinGecko coin has the same name or price-page headlines exist (possible token); capped at C (57.9) without points evidence.
methods.timeline: Evidence first: public token sale round, 'tokenomics/TGE/claim' headlines, TGE/tokenomics on the official site => near. Otherwise window = first priced round + comparables' first-round-to-TGE lag (p25/median/p75); 'overdue' = past the p75 date with no token news.
methods.allocation: Community pool $ = FDV estimate x airdrop % (comparables p25/median/p75). FDV estimate = disclosed valuation x1/1.5/3, else total raised x comparables FDV/raised p25/median/p75. Per $1k = pool x 1000 / today TVL: a ceiling that assumes the whole pool is split by capital at today's TVL. Real programs weight time, boosts and referrals, and TVL grows.
methods.value_user: Your $ = your share of total points x community pool $. Share = your points / total points when total is published; otherwise only a capital share (your deposit / TVL) can be used as a rough proxy for capital-weighted programs.

limits: No free source publishes participant counts for most points programs; news headline count and airdrops.io heat are attention/crowding proxies.
Homepage keyword scan misses single-page apps that render text with JavaScript; "no points evidence" is not proof there is no program.
Google News name matching can pick up unrelated companies with the same name; headlines are filtered to ones containing a crypto word.
Comparables are 2024-2026 large airdrops (survivorship: famous drops); small protocols often airdrop far less or never.
DefiLlama /raises API is paid (402); funding comes from the public defillama.com/raises page data and per-protocol raises.
